=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19977-19983 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The duplicate-post check in persist_orch_group_failures compares the cached marker's created_at with the member's own newest_failure_ts (set in scripts/persist_orchestrator.py group_failures). That timestamp identifies the failure, not the grouping episode. So when a member is grouped again with no new journal entry of its own, the old marker still passes `created_at >= $ts` and the "## Paused" comment is skipped. Two paths trigger this: (a) the member is released as owner_key_changed, owner_changed or journal_absent and then regrouped under the same owner and key, for example when the owner's key goes K→K2→K; (b) PERSIST_ORCH_FAILURE_GROUPING_ENABLED is switched off and back on within the 24 h window, because the switch-off cleanup removes grouped_under but leaves the comment on the issue.
  WHY: The item is paused again (hidden from check-stalls and the governor) with no comment. This breaks the P8 rule "post one comment per item when it is grouped" and contradicts the agents.d fragment's statement that "a marker from an earlier grouping episode does not count". The pause is still bounded by PERSIST_ORCH_GROUP_MAX_HOURS. Severity: sonnet, luna and glm rated it MAJOR; minimax gave no severity but rated the hardening risk 5.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19855,19967 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run added the loop variable pog_ts at line 19967 (`while IFS=$'\t' read -r pog_issue pog_owner pog_key pog_ts; do`), but it is missing from the `local` declaration at line 19855, so it leaks into the poller's global shell scope.
  WHY: Nothing fails today. A future global named pog_ts would be overwritten without warning, and the stale value persists between ticks. Severity: sonnet, gemini and glm rated it NIT; luna listed it only as a hardening item.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19978 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The duplicate-post search string `--arg m "AI_PERSIST_GROUPED_V1 key=${pog_key} owner=${pog_owner} "` has no `<!-- ` prefix. A model-written journal note is shown verbatim in the pipeline-login journal comment (scripts/attempt_journal.py:299; _scrub only escapes `<!--`/`-->`), so a note containing that text would match the check.
  WHY: The journal comment is newer than its own entries, so the timestamp check also passes and the "## Paused" comment is wrongly skipped. This also bypasses the "note is never read" contract. The pause is still bounded by PERSIST_ORCH_GROUP_MAX_HOURS. Severity: glm rated it NIT, sonnet listed it as hardening, gemini and minimax gave no severity.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

When a member is regrouped with no new journal entry, it is paused again without a comment.
